sql: SELECT SUM(item_totals.item_total - o.discount_amount - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)) AS net_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS item_total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) item_totals ON o.order_id = item_totals.order_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount FROM refunds GROUP BY order_id) r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE c.is_test = false AND o.status = 'completed' AND (o.ordered_at + INTERVAL '5 hours 30 minutes') >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND (o.ordered_at + INTERVAL '5 hours 30 minutes') < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(item_totals.item_total - o.discount_amount AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS item_total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) item_totals ON o.order_id = item_totals.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND c.is_test = false

sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS active_customers FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE (c.is_test IS NULL OR c.is_test = false) AND o.status = 'completed' AND cast(o.ordered_at + interval '5 hours 30 minutes' as date) BETWEEN cast('2026-09-30' as date) - interval '89 days' AND cast('2026-09-30' as date)
assumptions: Active customers are counted based on having at least one completed order in the 90 days ending on 2026-09-30 IST, inclusive.

sql: WITH customer_first_completed_order AS (SELECT c.customer_id, MIN(CAST(o.ordered_at + INTERVAL '5 hours 30 minutes' AS DATE)) AS first_order_date FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.is_test = false AND o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id) SELECT count(customer_id) AS new_customers FROM customer_first_completed_order WHERE first_order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND first_order_date <= DATE '2026-07-31'
assumptions: July 2026 refers to the IST dates from 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-31 inclusive.

sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('completed', 'cancelled', 'returned') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 4) AS cancellation_rate FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.is_test = false AND (o.ordered_at + INTERVAL '5 hours 30 minutes') >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND (o.ordered_at + INTERVAL '5 hours 30 minutes') < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
assumptions: Year to date for 2026 is from 2026-01-01 to 2026-09-30 inclusive in IST.

sql: SELECT sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE c.is_test = false AND o.status != 'cancelled' AND (o.ordered_at + INTERVAL '5 hours 30 minutes') >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND (o.ordered_at + INTERVAL '5 hours 30 minutes') < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00'

SELECT count(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE (o.ordered_at + INTERVAL '5 hours 30 minutes')::date = DATE '2026-08-15' AND (c.is_test = false OR c.is_test IS NULL)
assumptions: Customers with is_test IS NULL are treated as non-test customers.

sql: SELECT COUNT(o.order_id) AS pending_orders_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'pending' AND (c.is_test = false OR c.is_test IS NULL)
assumptions: Customers with is_test IS NULL are treated as non-test accounts.

sql: SELECT count(*) AS repeat_customers FROM (SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND (c.is_test = false OR c.is_test IS NULL) GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING count(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 2)
assumptions: A repeat customer is defined by having 2 or more completed orders over all time, excluding test accounts.

sql: WITH customer_revenue AS (SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0) - COALESCE(MAX(o.discount_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS ltv FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id AND o.status = 'completed' LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE c.is_test = false GROUP BY c.customer_id) SELECT customer_id, ltv FROM customer_revenue ORDER BY ltv DESC LIMIT 5
assumptions: Discount amount is per order and applied once per order in calculation of LTV.

sql: SELECT SUM(item_total - discount_amount - COALESCE(refund_total, 0)) AS net_revenue FROM (SELECT o.order_id, o.discount_amount, (SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) FROM order_items WHERE order_id = o.order_id) AS item_total, (SELECT SUM(refund_amount) FROM refunds WHERE order_id = o.order_id) AS refund_total FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.is_test = false AND o.status = 'completed' AND CAST(o.ordered_at + INTERVAL '5 hours 30 minutes' AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-24' AND DATE '2026-09-30')
assumptions: The last 7 days ending on 2026-09-30 inclusive are 2026-09-24 to 2026-09-30 in IST.

sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('completed', 'returned') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) AS return_rate FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.is_test = false AND (o.ordered_at + INTERVAL '5 hours 30 minutes') >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND (o.ordered_at + INTERVAL '5 hours 30 minutes') < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND o.status IN ('completed', 'returned')
assumptions: August 2026 is defined as 2026-08-01 through 2026-08-31 inclusive in IST.

sql: SELECT c.city, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) - SUM(o.discount_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS net_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount FROM refunds GROUP BY order_id) r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE c.is_test = false AND o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.acquisition_channel, sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS gmv FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE c.is_test = false AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.acquisition_channel
assumptions: GMV is calculated across all time for each acquisition channel.

sql: SELECT t1.category, SUM(t1.quantity * t1.unit_price) AS gmv FROM order_items AS t1 INNER JOIN orders AS t2 ON t1.order_id = t2.order_id INNER JOIN customers AS t3 ON t2.customer_id = t3.customer_id WHERE t3.is_test = false AND t2.status != 'cancelled' AND (t2.ordered_at + INTERVAL '5 hours 30 minutes') >= TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND (t2.ordered_at + INTERVAL '5 hours 30 minutes') < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY t1.category
assumptions: July 2026 is defined as July 1 to July 31, 2026 in IST.

sql: WITH customer_first_completed_order AS (SELECT c.customer_id, MIN(CAST(o.ordered_at + INTERVAL '5 hours 30 minutes' AS DATE)) AS first_order_date FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.is_test = false AND o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id), customer_first_month AS (SELECT customer_id, date_trunc('month', first_order_date) AS month_start FROM customer_first_completed_order WHERE first_order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND first_order_date <= '2026-09-30') SELECT month_start AS month, count(customer_id) AS new_customers FROM customer_first_month GROUP BY month_start ORDER BY month_start

sql: SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount) AS total_refunded FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND c.is_test = false
